title: Measured value short floating-point report
purpose: Add a distinct monitoring/report parser path using a recommended monitoring TypeID with one floating-point information object.
expected_behavior: Parser accepts a monitoring ASDU for TypeID 13 measured short floating-point value with one information object and spontaneous cause.
constraints_preserved: TypeID 13 matches supplied mapping for M_ME_NC_1
Spontaneous monitoring style encoded with a standard two-octet cause field
Information object carries 3-byte IOA, 4-byte IEEE-754 float payload, and one quality byte
APCI length 0x0f matches four control bytes plus eleven ASDU bytes
issue_safety_notes: Benign monitoring seed; uses straightforward one-object reporting structure rather than oversized or nested payloads.
